SUPERVISORS OF THE CHECKLIST SESSION The Landaff Supervisors of the Checklist will hold a session on Wednesday, August 26,2026, 4:00-5:00 PM at the Town Hall. The purpose of the meeting is to register new voters and checklist maintenance. No changes to party affiliation can be made as the deadline has passed and cannot be changed until after the NH State Primary on September 8, 2026. Anyone wishing to verify their voter registration status may access it on the Secretary of State’s Voter Information Lookup Page at app.sos.nh.gov or by visiting the Landaff Town Clerk. Jaye Michaelis, Nate Hamilton, Annette Kohler
